prompts: BACE1 is an aspartic-acid protease important in the pathogenesis of Alzheimer's disease, and in the formation of myelin sheaths. BACE1 is a member of family of aspartic proteases. Same as other aspartic proteases, BACE1 is a bilobal enzyme, each lobe contributing a catalytic Asp residue, with an extended active site cleft localized between the two lobes of the molecule. The assay tests whether the molecule can bind to the BACE1 protein. Is this molecule effective to the assay?
